text:
Lena: quick post-launch triage  decide whether to include small retry-backoff tweak in tomorrow's hotpatch or leave for mini-wave.
Marco: retry tweak reduces transient 429s for long-tail customers, estimate ~1 dev day + smoke.
Ivy: QE only has 24hrs for hotpatch. adding code might squeeze perf checks.
Darren: can we ship with a runtime flag default-on and a fast rollback? if so, include it.
Lena: ops check?
Darren: yes I can add a kill-switch to routing and monitor 429 rate; rollback if 429s increase or p99 latency regresses > 15%.
Marco: then plan: include backoff tweak in hotpatch, owners: Marco PR, Ivy QE, Darren ops/runbook, Lena release notes.
release-bot: canary scheduled: v2026.06.18-patchA -> Tomorrow 09:00 UTC to "canary-small". Checks: smoke, 429-rate, p99 latency.
Ivy: QE will run 5 smoke + 2 perf checks focused on long-tail flows. need 30m pairing with Marco.
Marco: can pair today 16:00 UTC.
Lena: summary: include backoff tweak in hotpatch with rollback triggers. pre-canary sync 08:30 UTC. Ping here for blockers.
All: ack.
